'''Baxley''': {{legend0|#a5b0ff|40–50%}} {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} {{legend0|#6674de|60–70%}} {{legend0|#584cde|70–80%}} | title = [[Governor of Alabama|Governor]] | before_election = [[Bob Riley]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Bob Riley]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Alabama sidebar}} The '''2006 Alabama gubernatorial election''' occurred on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Republican Governor [[Bob Riley]] defeated Democratic Lieutenant Governor [[Lucy Baxley]]. Riley garnered 21% of [[African Americans]]' votes. Riley was the first Republican to carry the counties [[Bibb County, Alabama|Bibb]], [[Cherokee County, Alabama|Cherokee]], [[Etowah County, Alabama|Etowah]], [[Jackson County, Alabama|Jackson]], and [[Lauderdale County, Alabama|Lauderdale]] since Reconstruction.
